title: Confessor makes Niv's draw life-neutral, so Skirge Familiar's discard pays for itself
summary: Reality Fracture's Orzhov Niv-Mizzet converts any life gained into that many cards, paid for with the same life. A bracket-4 Archidekt primer pairs it with Confessor, which gains a life whenever any player discards. Each Skirge Familiar activation then discards a card for a black mana, gains one life, and Niv turns that life back into the replacement draw: life neutral, hand neutral, one mana ahead. Discarding Kozilek shuffles the graveyard back, so the library never empties. A second builder deliberately avoids the instant-kill loops and runs the same commander as a bracket-2 lifegain draw engine, and Commander Spellbook already registers two-card infinite draw with Sheoldred.

notes: The primer states the loop mechanically - discard outlet into the lifegain trigger into the draw - rather than naming the commander as a set-review highlight.
The pieces are old and cheap: Confessor is an Odyssey common and Skirge Familiar a Modern Horizons 2 uncommon, so the line does not depend on Reality Fracture cards.
The same lifegain-on-discard shape is already registered on Commander Spellbook with Oloro in the Niv slot, which is independent support for the mechanism.
Two builders reached different shells on purpose - a bracket-4 control-into-combo list and a bracket-2 engine that skips the instant kills - so the commander has room in it rather than one line.
Neither builder reports games played, so this is reasoned rather than tested.

alternatives.name: Confessor plus a free discard outlet
alternatives.reason: Confessor triggers on any player discarding, so a repeatable outlet converts the commander's life-for-cards clause into a mana engine that costs nothing.

alternatives.name: Kozilek, Butcher of Truth as the fuel tank
alternatives.reason: Being put into the graveyard from anywhere shuffles the graveyard into the library, so discarding it refills the deck the loop is drawing through.

alternatives.name: Sanguine Bond style symmetric lifegain kills
alternatives.reason: The second builder cut them on purpose, because the drain loops end the game before the draw engine does anything and make the commander interchangeable.
